lead: Aditya Chopra is an Indian film director, born on 21 May 1971 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, he is 55 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Filmfare Award for Best Director.
This profile collects the Aditya facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Aditya Chopra — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Aditya Chopra was born on 21 May 1971 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Yash Chopra and his mother, Pamela Chopra. He is a sibling of Uday Chopra.
He received his education at Bombay Scottish School and Sydenham College.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi and Punjabi.
